common.applies_to: Bush rose; dead-wood identification and removal
mil_references: ARC-BUSHROSE-DEADWOOD-01, AF-1 (High) — pith colour as the definitive dead/living signal
ARC-BUSHROSE-DEADWOOD-01, AF-2 (Moderate) — external bark colour as a supporting signal
ARC-BUSHROSE-DEADWOOD-01, AF-7 (High) — cut back to living tissue

content.identity: Royal Horticultural Society, "Rose pruning: general tips," https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/roses/pruning-guide, accessed during FRD-BUSHROSE-DEADWOOD-01 research
content.relevance: Primary reference-body source for the core dead-wood identification and removal rule; the most heavily-cited source in this commission.

provenance.note: v1.5: MIL references for ARC-BUSHROSE-HARDPRUNE-01 / ARC-BUSHROSE-NOFLOWERS-01 added, approved by Shaphan in chat, 2 October 2026. v1.4 retired.
